messages:
lina: FYI CI is spiking failures on model-onboard/quant-smoke. Seen in two runs in a row, failing tests around 'eval_harness.integration.distributed'.
omar: I noticed metrics dashboard shows token-count and failure-rate doubling for the same inputs. Could be duplicate execution.
ci-bot: build/quant-smoke #482 failed — timeout in eval_runner_integration_test.py::test_distributed_end_to_end
jia: Logs from runner show duplicate completions for task ids. snippet:
```
I0319 12:44:01 runner.go:213 complete task_id=tx-9a1 status=ok seq=42
I0319 12:44:02 runner.go:217 complete task_id=tx-9a1 status=ok seq=42 (duplicate)
```
omar: That looks like an ack reorder or requeue race. Could be lease expiry + reschedule during backpressure.
ops-kyle: Any recent changes to shard resharding or lease TTLs?
lina: We rolled in the new resharder last week (PR #6059) which shortens lease to 2s during scale-up; maybe too aggressive.
ryan: Also saw kvcache eviction logs the same timeframe; eviction + reshard could evict prefix mapping causing re-dispatch.
marc: Repro steps I ran locally: run ~1000 concurrent shards with quantized model, kill one worker, watch tasks get requeued and then duplicated a few ms later.
omar: Hypothesis: when a worker loses lease, dispatcher resends tasks but previous worker may still push completion due to delayed ack path; no dedupe on completion ingestion.
jia: Quick patch idea: add dedupe based on task_id + completion_nonce persisted for 30s. Cheap and avoids double-counting metrics.
ops-kyle: Can we also increase lease TTL to 5s as stopgap? That reduces reschedule churn.
lina: I can open a hotfix PR with both: persist nonce + bump TTL. Also add a unit test simulating duplicate complete events.
ryan: We should add an integration test in CI that simulates worker lag and ensures metrics don't inflate. Maybe a new test in eval_runner_integration_test::test_duplicate_completion_dedup.
marc: I'll add a DB query to dashboard that filters unique task_ids — for now to backfill correct numbers. SQL: `select count(distinct task_id) from eval_runs where run_id = 'ci-quant-smoke'`
omar: Long term, consider making completion path idempotent at ingestion (upsert on task_id) and emit telemetry when duplicate is observed.
jia: I'll draft the PR for dedupe + test. Lina, can you handle the TTL bump?
lina: Yep. PRs incoming in next 2 hours. I'll tag infra-oncall. @ops-kyle please monitor CI when merged. :thumbsup:
ops-kyle: Will watch and mute alerts if we get a flood, but will keep tracing enabled.
ci-bot: build/quant-smoke #483 queued (triggered by lina)
